summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend regression for iteration-8 follow-up. Pricing contracts and portfolio signal formatting remain intact, but admin table row-hover still makes action button labels low-contrast and unreadable.

ui_bugs.issue: On row hover, button text inherits dark row text color while button background stays dark, causing unreadable labels.

issues: Measured contrast for hovered 'Update Credits' button text vs background was ~1.22:1 (fails readability expectations).

action_items: Fix admin hover cascade so button labels keep high contrast on hovered table rows (do not inherit dark row text into dark buttons).
Re-run targeted UI regression for admin hover + pricing labels + portfolio horizon formatting after CSS fix.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css has conflicting rules: row hover forces dark text globally and button rule sets color: inherit, which directly causes dark-on-dark button text.
backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>700 lines guideline), increasing regression risk for targeted changes.
seed_data_creation: No explicit seed file created. API tests created temporary user data and cleaned up user via admin delete in test finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file passed all 3 tests on public endpoint (multibagger=2, fno=2, custom-position=1, portfolio signed horizons). Frontend confirms pricing labels and portfolio formatting are intact. Remaining failure is admin hover button contrast on first row (computed fg rgb(15,23,42) on bg rgb(30,41,59), contrast ~1.22:1).
rca of the issue: Repro: login as owner -> Admin tab -> hover any user row -> action button text becomes very dark. Root cause: App.css hover cascade sets row text to --hoverTextSafeColor and '[data-testid="admin-users-table"] tbody tr:hover button { color: inherit !important; }' forces buttons to inherit same dark color while their background stays slate-800. Mitigation: override hovered action button text to a light color (e.g. text-slate-100) or remove inherit for buttons in hovered admin rows.
